Upgrade Concrete Floors With Durable Coatings

Owner-led projects with documented prep and locally sourced materials

Apex Epoxy Flooring Solutions brings epoxy floor coatings and concrete polishing to residential, commercial, industrial, and government facilities throughout Northeast Ohio. From Aurora and Kent to Cleveland, Akron, Lakewood, and Youngstown, your slab gets evaluated with care before a single product touches the surface. Each project begins with a free floor inspection and estimate to assess condition, identify repair needs, and match the right system to your goals.


You'll know what to expect before work begins—detailed scope, surface prep strategy, material selection, and timeline outlined in straightforward terms. Because every floor is different, mechanical preparation is tailored to your concrete's current state, ensuring proper adhesion and long-term bonding. Whether you're upgrading a garage, warehouse, showroom, or production floor, you're part of the conversation at every stage.


Apex Epoxy Flooring Solutions operates with full insurance and direct owner involvement from layout through final cure. Premium coatings sourced locally are chosen for their compatibility with Ohio's climate challenges, delivering performance that holds up season after season. Your floor becomes more than a surface—it becomes infrastructure you can depend on for years ahead.


Call to schedule your free inspection and estimate across Northeast Ohio.
